turns.question: Which customer has spent the most with us over all their orders, and how much?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that ranks individual customers: no metric has a per-customer dimension (revenue can only be split by customer country, signup date, order status and similar), so I can't name the top-spending customer. The closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur), Active customers (customers_distinct) and Repeat customers (repeat_customers), which I can give in total or by customer country.
